newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan April forex turnover down 11 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan April forex turnover down 11 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Average daily turnover on Taiwan's foreign exchange market in April fell 11 percent to US$4.32 billion from April 1996, the central bank said on Saturday.
The April forex turnover represented a 5.1 percent decline from March, a bank statement said.

Of the daily turnover, 20.7 percent was between the U.S. dollar and the yen and 13.2 percent was between the dollar and the mark. Trade among the Taiwan dollar and foreign currencies accounted for 43 percent of the total.
Spot trading took 71.2 percent of the total, cross-currency swaps 11.8 percent, margin trading 8.4 percent, forward trading 6.1 percent, and options and futures 2.5 percent.
Taiwan began financial derivatives trading in early 1994.
